title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I missed Cabrera talking earlier, can you provide what the options for getting the knee better in the off-season are? No quotes or attribution, just something vague I can build off

His off season concentration will be strengthening his lower half, increasing flexibility and ROM, and overall becoming leaner and stronger.  Really basic stuff on this one Anthony.  I have no idea what Miggy said however.
